note: High-detail chart regions (Iteration 14; Sweden and New Zealand: Regions and Harbours 2026). Each folder holds region.json, navmask.png, land.json and graph.json, built by tools/navigation/build_region.py. 'parent' is the chart a region refines: 'europe' (the default) or 'world'. Regions never overlap. The parent chart is used wherever no region covers. See DEV_GUIDES/CHART_REGIONS.md.
